intent: Bind the first-class Define package to its standalone runtime while preserving product meaning, owner boundaries, exact source evidence, and the distinction between implementation evidence, conformance, adoption, and authority.

Alch declarations compile through source-linked ontology, Craft, and DomainSpec candidate projections.
Local executable evidence exists without granting adoption or conformance.
Current capability records identify the standalone runtime and no retired source contract.
May establish only the evaluated obligation outcomes for exact tested bytes.
May adopt one digest-bound runtime after separate review.

external_change.reason: This private rebinding changes no external package, publication, deployment, or consumer installation.

required_gates: deterministic Alch compilation and runtime regression pass
independent behavioral conformance assessment before any conformance claim
transition_options: retain candidate status after local implementation evidence
adopt the exact digest-bound runtime after independent assessment
revise the runtime binding without changing Product Capability identity
owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus Define capability and runtime owners
claim_ceiling: This record binds a candidate package to a standalone candidate runtime. It does not establish behavioral conformance, adoption, activation, publication, release, deployment, canonical promotion, or external authority.
